_meta.validation_notes: News/professional places first. City names normally take à; Le Caire and Le Cap retain their article and take au. Feminine countries and vowel-initial countries take en, masculine consonant-initial countries au, plurals aux; conventional articleless island/country names take à. Region forms are lexicalized and individually checked.
